name: @dcasegr/amm-client
description: The Open Exchange client (skein-amm): reads, swap, pool deploy / close / rebalance, move back and positions over a BRC-100 wallet, bound to one exchange by createClient. No React, no styles, no wallet provider.

scripts.build: npm --prefix ../engine run build && rm -rf dist && ../ui/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/vendor/runar && cp ../ui/src/vendor/runar/LICENSE ../ui/src/vendor/runar/NOTICE dist/vendor/runar/
